title: Quartermap: risk-adjusted roadmap for Hosted API + Model Catalog
creator: Avery Liu
description: Introduce a 'Quartermap' — a risk-adjusted, capacity- and SLA-aware quarterly roadmap specifically for Hosted API and the Model Catalog. The Quartermap prioritizes initiatives by combined business risk, capacity exposure, and downstream customer impact so we can sequence model rotations, canaries, and capacity commits that minimize cost while protecting SLAs.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Quartermap framework published and reviewed by Eng/Reliability/Finance; 2) Three prioritized initiative lanes (Grow, Stabilize, Hedge) with owners and measurable KPIs; 3) Simulation of capacity hedges for top two lanes completed and results attached; 4) Rollout playbook (canary windows, fallback variants, communication playbook) documented in Confluence.
milestones: M1: Framework draft + cross-functional review completed (2025-11-22)
M2: Scenario simulations for capacity hedges (high-traffic and seasonal) completed (2025-12-08)
M3: Roadmap lanes prioritized and engineering sprint commitments agreed (2025-12-15)
M4: Canary & fallback playbook merged into operations runbook (2026-01-05)
M5: Executive sign-off and Q1 runway published (2026-01-12)
deliverables: Canary & rollback playbook for hosted-model rotations
Stakeholder comms template and release calendar
